final: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON CAST(c.zoneref AS BLOB) = CAST(s.zoneregistry AS BLOB) GROUP BY s.healtheval), overall_total AS (SELECT SUM(group_count) AS total FROM group_counts), group_shares AS (SELECT g.group_count, CAST(g.group_count AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM group_counts AS g JOIN overall_total AS t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM group_shares), kept AS (SELECT gs.group_count, gs.share, gs.share - oa.avg_share AS share_difference FROM group_shares AS gs JOIN overall_average AS oa ON oa.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE gs.share > oa.avg_share) SELECT AVG(group_count), AVG(share), AVG(share_difference) FROM kept
